citations.description: Ticket acceptance criteria: '- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean.' — no attestation in ticket comments and no codebase artifact to read.

findings.detail: This criterion requires running external tooling (linter and type checker) against the codebase. It is untagged (codebase-verifiable by default), but no evidence of lint/typecheck cleanliness is observable from static file inspection. The ticket has no comments recording a passing lint/typecheck run, and there is no in-repo artifact (e.g. a CI badge, a recorded output file) that would confirm this. Cannot verify from the repository alone.
findings.remediation: Record a concrete attestation in the ticket comments: the CI run URL or commit SHA at which `make lint` and `make typecheck` both passed, with the observed outcome (exit code 0 / no errors).

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
